scope: Independent offline acceptance: Empty-only USB provisioning and public diagnostics
workflow: Stage BOTH RAM candidates before any write, with separate powered USB sessions and RF off/TX disarmed.
Confirm full local public tuples and opposite peer pins.
Commit each exactly once while both candidates remain valid.
Read back both completed tuples before a separately deliberate reboot.
Halt whole pair after uncertainty/candidate loss; no automatic retry, regeneration, rollback, overwrite or activation.
non_atomicity: RAM-only staging cannot provide atomic two-device persistence. Identity-last write can complete despite error: current instance stays terminal/uncertain, while later deliberate boot may verify a complete authorized tuple without resuming the failed pair.

contract.stage: No-repair snapshot proves all four private keys absent; exactly one 32-byte entropy fill, clamp and real Monocypher derivation. Repeated stage rechecks Empty and returns the same public tuple. 120-second lifetime from trusted 64-bit monotonic uptime.
contract.commit: Exact expected binding and explicit canonical peer tuple, fresh Empty check, complete service lease. Order ledger0 initialization, ledger1 pin, identity0 completion, exact readback after each. No runtime activation.
contract.context: Actual service lock, native RF off/not busy, TX disarmed, no queues/private runtime/open SettingsEdit/pending reboot or bootloader operation; NodeDB/hardware-node collision checks; unified same-store read snapshot and persistence adapter.
contract.failure: Stage outputs preserved on rejection; key copies wiped on expiry/cancel/terminal failure. Attempted commit failure terminal, no blind retry or repair.
contract.diagnostic: Validated public tuples/state/error only; never scalar/raw record/key handle, store repair/initialization, RF state changes or activation.
contract.ingress: Dedicated bounded USB CDC dispatcher, separate from Companion/BleHost/RF admin. Clear candidate on session loss/disconnect/overflow/reset/timeout/cancel.

independent_cases: Passive construction; denied lease/quiescence has no entropy/write side effects.
Each private key present in any shape prevents stage before entropy, including zero/truncated/oversized records.
One fill produces exact canonical fixture binding and preserves every persistent byte; repeat stage draws nothing.
Entropy/read failure, callback reentry, gate loss and expiry preserve rejected output and cannot regenerate.
Wrong expected binding, noncanonical/self/wrong-CRC/colliding peer tuples write nothing.
Storage becoming nonempty after stage is rejected by fresh check without overwrite.
Paired happy path pins exact opposite tuples once, preserves Public config/NodeDB and requires later explicit startup.
Every before/after/torn write and readback-error/mismatch cutpoint freezes without retry or completion after earlier error.
Final complete-but-error remains uncertain in-session; fresh boot distinguishes verified complete from partial without repair.
Expiry/quiescence loss during entropy, snapshot, each write/readback prevents success publication.
Cancellation/session loss/expiry and terminal states cannot obtain a new candidate in same lifecycle.
A full 32-bit millisecond elapsed cycle still expires under the 64-bit clock contract.
A competing writer that fills storage makes repeated stage terminal without returning stale public success.
Diagnostics stage public outputs atomically and never reinterpret partial/corrupt/ambiguous/revoked state as Empty.
Fragmented/oversized/stale/unknown USB frames stay bounded and cannot enter BLE/RF admin or repeat mutations.
Host pair helper aborts after uncertainty/candidate loss, without automatic retries, reboot or activation.
limits: No hardware entropy quality, physical USB or hard flash/scheduler latency proof.
NVS CRC/plaintext is not hostile rollback or physical-key protection.
Local USB endpoint/host and operator public-tuple selection remain trust assumptions.
Parent paused integration/transport while owner moves offline; local review only.
